purpose: One truthful baseline: install the repository's own pinned dependency closure and run the repository's own declared build command, in the nearest honest legacy cell.

declaredCell.whereDeclared: Dockerfile, frontend build stage: `FROM node:14.18.2-alpine3.14 AS frontend` followed by `RUN yarn` and `RUN yarn build`

otherDeclarations.ciNodeMatrix: none — the three GitHub workflows (build-and-push-dev-image, build-and-push-release-image, codeql) never install Node directly; the image workflows delegate to the Dockerfile.

declaredCell.declaredPackageManager: yarn (invoked bare in the Dockerfile), corroborated by the committed web/yarn.lock in yarn v1 format
declaredCell.declaredBuildCommand: yarn build, which web/package.json expands to `tsc && vite build`

cellUsed.npm: 8.19.4 (bundled; used only to fetch yarn into the cell)
cellUsed.packageManagerProvenance: yarn 1 is not present on the host. yarn@1.22.19 was installed with npm into the baseline cell only (.versionless/cache/react-memos-v0-1-3-baseline/pm), never globally and never into the repository. 1.22.19 is the last yarn 1 release and is era-appropriate for a mid-2022 yarn v1 lockfile.

runtimeProvenance.reusedFrom: an already-acquired and digest-verified runtime in this workspace's cache (first pinned by fixtures/react-boilerplate-v4/fixture.json); no new runtime download was made by this unit

cellDeviationFromDeclared.used: Node 16.20.2 on darwin-arm64 (glibc-free BSD host, native arm64)
cellDeviationFromDeclared.justification: Node 14 has no darwin-arm64 build at all — official darwin-arm64 binaries begin at Node 16. Honouring 14.18.2 on this host would require either Rosetta 2 translation of a darwin-x64 Node 14 (which would then also force the x64 esbuild binary, changing the bundler's execution mode) or a linux/alpine container, neither of which is in this unit's scope. Node 16.20.2 is the oldest natively-runnable Node on this host and sits inside the era policy for the Vite 2.9 line (Node 14/16). It is labelled a deviation, not a pin.
cellDeviationFromDeclared.honestLabel: era-consistent, not repository-pinned: the repository pins Node 14.18.2 and this baseline ran on Node 16.20.2.
cellDeviationFromDeclared.unknownPreserved: Whether the outcomes below reproduce under the repository's declared Node 14.18.2 alpine cell was NOT tested and is not claimed either way. The observed failure is a TypeScript typecheck over lockfile-pinned .d.ts files, which is not obviously Node-version-sensitive, but that reasoning is an inference and is recorded as such rather than as a finding.

commandNotes.frozenLockfile: yarn ACCEPTED --frozen-lockfile, which proves web/yarn.lock is consistent with web/package.json and that nothing was re-resolved against today's registry. The installed tree is the closure the repository itself pins.
commandNotes.ignoreScripts: Lifecycle scripts were disabled by policy. yarn reported `warning Ignored scripts due to flag.`

buildAttemptA.label: the declared build, run exactly as the repository declares it
buildAttemptA.failedIn: tsc — the typecheck gate, before the bundler ran at all
errors: node_modules/@types/react-dom/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts(3162,13): error TS2717: Subsequent property declarations must have the same type. Property 'dialog' must be of type 'DetailedHTMLProps<DialogHTMLAttributes<HTMLDialogElement>, HTMLDialogElement>', but here has type 'DetailedHTMLProps<DialogHTMLAttributes<HTMLDialogElement>, HTMLDialogElement>'.

node_modules/@types/react-dom/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts(3194,13): error TS2717: Subsequent property declarations must have the same type. Property 'link' must be of type 'DetailedHTMLProps<LinkHTMLAttributes<HTMLLinkElement>, HTMLLinkElement>', but here has type 'DetailedHTMLProps<LinkHTMLAttributes<HTMLLinkElement>, HTMLLinkElement>'.

diagnosis.cause: web/yarn.lock pins two different copies of @types/react: 18.0.9 at the top level (from the direct devDependency range ^18.0.9) and 18.0.5 nested under @types/react-dom@18.0.4 (whose own dependency range is `@types/react "*"`, resolved in the lockfile to 18.0.5). web/tsconfig.json sets "skipLibCheck": false, so tsc checks both copies of react's declaration file and reports them as conflicting global JSX declarations.
diagnosis.notDrift: This is NOT present-day registry drift. Both versions come from the repository's own committed lockfile, and yarn accepted --frozen-lockfile. The condition is a property of the pinned revision.

buildAttemptB.label: ONE honestly-labeled deviation — NOT the declared build command, and NOT a baseline result
buildAttemptB.why: To determine whether the failure is confined to the typecheck gate or also affects the Vite 2 bundler, which is the property that matters for an old-Vite-to-Vite-8 migration fixture.
deviations: esbuild 0.14.36's install.js was run manually, because --ignore-scripts had suppressed it during the baseline install. The binary came from the lockfile-pinned optional dependency esbuild-darwin-arm64@0.14.36, so this was a local link rather than a download.
`vite build` was invoked directly, skipping the `tsc &&` half of the declared command.
warnings: Browserslist: caniuse-lite is outdated. (An advisory from the 2022-pinned caniuse-lite in the closure; it did not affect the exit status.)
buildAttemptB.whatThisEstablishes: The Vite 2.9.5 bundler transforms and bundles this application's source without error in this cell.
buildAttemptB.whatThisDoesNotEstablish: It does not make the declared `yarn build` succeed, it does not typecheck the application, and it does not establish that the emitted bundle runs correctly in a browser. Nothing here was loaded in a browser.

network.purpose: package-manager fetching for the yarn bootstrap and the pinned closure only
network.urlByUrlLedgerNote: Per-package fetches were performed by npm and yarn themselves and are recorded here in aggregate, not URL-by-URL in the source ledger. Every resolved URL in the closure points at registry.yarnpkg.com and carries an integrity hash; see closure.json.

cache.note: The baseline cell is a copy of web/ from the reconciled source. The reconciled source tree itself was never modified. Neither the installed tree nor the emitted dist is published into the repository.

nonclaims: A successful install establishes no build. A successful bundler run under a labelled deviation establishes no successful build of the declared command.
No browser was driven, no journey was exercised, and the Go backend was neither built nor run, so nothing here establishes that this application works.
This record establishes no migration feasibility, pilot status, production readiness, certification, or legal approval.
